violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface under cutting boards was not cleaned as frequently as required.--Nonfood contact surface Handles & doors to prep coolers were not cleaned as frequently as required.
Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities Floor under cooking equipment were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. - Sleeve of to-go containers (not in box) on floor in floral/produce cutting room. Single use items need to be off the floor.
